sentences.en: Situated on a hill, his house commands a fine view.
sentences.zh: 他家坐落在山顶上，可以俯瞰美丽的景色。

sentences.en: Viewed from a distance, the island looked like a cloud.
sentences.zh: 从远处看，那座岛屿就像一朵云。

sentences.en: We discussed the matter from an educational point of view.
sentences.zh: 我们从教育的角度讨论了这个问题。
